problems.quote: At the Nagpur session of the Congress in December 1920, Gandhi persuaded the party to adopt a programme of non‐cooperation
problems.problem: The Non-Cooperation programme was adopted at the Calcutta session (September 1920), not the Nagpur session (December 1920). Nagpur ratified it.
problems.correction: At the Calcutta session of the Congress in September 1920, Gandhi persuaded the party to adopt a programme of non‐cooperation
problems.verifierReason: Non-Cooperation adopted at Calcutta Sept 1920; Nagpur ratified. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: At the conference, Gandhi demanded immediate dominion status and safeguards for minorities
problems.problem: Gandhi demanded complete independence (Purna Swaraj), not dominion status, at the Second Round Table Conference.
problems.correction: At the conference, Gandhi demanded complete independence and safeguards for minorities
problems.verifierReason: Gandhi demanded complete independence at Second RTC, not dominion status. Correction accurate.

problems.problem: The Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act was enacted in 1954, not 1948. An ordinance was issued in 1948, but the Act came later.
problems.verifierReason: Correct: 1948 was an Ordinance; the Act was passed in 1954.

problems.problem: There was no Citizenship Act in 1949. The Constitution (adopted 1949, effective 1950) contained citizenship provisions (Articles 5–11); the first Citizenship Act was passed in 1955.
problems.verifierReason: Correct: No 1949 Act existed; citizenship derived from Constitution (adopted 1949) until 1955 Act.
